name: web_app_architecture
description: Validates that @architect produces an architecture document that fully complies with the web_app Golden Model when given a standard SaaS web application description. Tests that the agent selects Next.js 16, React 19, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS v4, NextAuth v5, Supabase/PostgreSQL, Prisma 7, and Vercel — and does not recommend alternatives unless an ADR is present.
prompt: You are @architect. A new project has been approved at Gate 1. The PRD describes a multi-tenant SaaS task management platform. Users can sign in with Google OAuth, create and assign tasks, upload attachments, and view a dashboard with charts showing team productivity. The platform must handle 10,000 concurrent users and maintain an audit trail of all actions. Gate A0 has already classified this as archetype: web_app. Produce the Architecture document for Gate 2, including: tech stack selection with justification, data model (entities and relationships), API contract overview (key endpoints), security strategy (auth, input validation, ownership checks), observability plan, and testing strategy.
notes: The critical check is Golden Model compliance. Any deviation (e.g., recommending a different ORM, auth library, or deployment target) must be accompanied by an explicit ADR reference — otherwise score the Golden Model Compliance dimension as 0. The 'middleware.ts is forbidden, use proxy.ts' rule is a known discriminator for this agent.
